title: God’s Power and the Ark
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops and wonders, and tonight a stone statue falls flat and two cows carry the ark home on their own: Wren wonders at a thunderstorm and remembers who is stronger than the storm.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because God’s power is a wonder, and Wren loves to stop and wonder. In Wren’s world today: a big thunderstorm rolls in. BOOM goes the thunder, and the windows rattle. Wren’s heart jumps. Then she presses her nose to the glass and watches the lightning light up the whole sky. “Heavenly Father made all of this,” she whispers, “and He is even stronger than the storm.” Her scared feeling turns into a wondering feeling. Just like the Israelites getting the Ark back, Wren learned that nothing is more powerful than Heavenly Father.
